About the job

About Darkroom

Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.

At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Shadow, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.

Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.

What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000) and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom’s role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.

About The Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Associate - a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug-and-play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem-solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high-performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands-on throughout the lifecycle - translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life


Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data-driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e-commerce clients. 
On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns. 
You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages
On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars. 
You’ll work directly with our in-house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to live, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails. 
You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in-house designers. 
Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas. 
Execute automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations. 


Who You Are:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Associate to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.


You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e-commerce clients. 
You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP. 
You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e-commerce marketing industry. 
You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting. 
You're used to working in a fast-paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients. 
You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing. 


You should apply if this sounds like you:


2-4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e-commerce, etc. 
Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast-paced environment. 
Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers. 
Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside of the box to create new best-in-class customer experiences. 
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level. 


What It's Like To Work At Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include the Brazil and Spain.

About the job

About Aplazo

Aplazo is Mexico’s leading “buy now, pay later” platform, giving consumers flexible, transparent payment solutions while helping merchants grow their sales. We’re a fast-growing Series B fintech backed by top global investors, combining technology, data, and design to redefine financial access.

Role’s Mission

Aplazo needs one creative owner who puts ideas on the table and makes sure they ship on-brand. Today that function—concept, narrative, trend judgment, and craft ownership—is split across leadership, the content team, and the agency. This role concentrates it in one person, giving the brand a single voice and a single eye, from idea to final piece.

The Creative & Brand Guardian owns what the brand says and how it looks. You originate the concept and narrative behind campaigns and tentpole moments, and you are the last word on craft—nothing ships that doesn’t meet the bar.

Key Responsibilities

CONCEPT & NARRATIVE


Put ideas on the table — Originate campaign concepts and brand narrative; ideas start here, not just execution.
Own tentpole storytelling — Define the storytelling and creative territory for the brand’s biggest moments of the year.
Set the trend judgment — Decide what the brand jumps on, when, how—and when it doesn’t.
Write briefs that give direction — Translate concept into clear briefs the content and design team can execute against.


BRAND GUARDIANSHIP & CRAFT


Own the design system — Be the steward of the brand book—know it well enough to defend it and evolve it.
Guard visual quality — Review and correct the team’s output before it ships; you are the last word on craft.
Direct the creative work of others — Give creative and design direction to the Content Specialists, correcting with a clear point of view.


This role does not own operations: the calendar, scheduling, and publishing live with Marketing Ops.

Must Have


5+ years of experience in art direction, creative direction, or brand design (agency or in-house)
Background in design or art direction—not a pure content strategist; hands-on craft skills are non-negotiable

Experience directing and correcting the work of designers or content creators

Nice to Have


Experience in fintech, retail, or other fast-moving consumer brands
Background managing or briefing external contributors
Motion, video, or art direction for social-first formats
Experience building or evolving a brand book from scratch


Skills

Technical Skills: Art direction, brand systems, campaign concepting, generative AI tools (Midjourney, Runway, etc.), Adobe Creative Suite

Soft Skills: Strong point of view, ability to give and receive critique, cross-functional communication, decisiveness under ambiguity

Languages


Spanish (native/advanced)
English (advanced)

There is a defined visual system that nothing ships without going through—craft consistency across every channel

You'll partner closely with Associate Directors of Retention and cross-functional teams to develop and deploy high-performing campaigns for some of the fastest-growing DTC brands in the world — translating data into strategy and strategy into revenue.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance - while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina and Mexico.

A Day in the Life


Lead the execution of email and SMS strategies for a portfolio of DTC/e-commerce clients, working alongside our Associate Directors of Retention to align on goals and priorities. 
Own the end-to-end campaign deployment process - copywriting, briefing, testing, QA, deployment, and performance monitoring. 
Contribute to monthly retention marketing calendars and proactively bring creative campaign concepts to clients and internal teams. 
Lead portions of client calls - presenting content ideas and managing the revision and approval process with confidence. 
Partner with the in-house design team to shape the creative direction of campaigns and flows, ensuring visual and copy are working together to drive results. 
Build, audit, and optimize automation flows, pop-up logic, segmentation strategies, and app integrations. 
Analyze campaign and flow performance and surface actionable recommendations that improve retention KPIs over time. 


Who You Are:

We're looking for a Retention Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e-commerce, DTC clients.


You have 3-5 years of experience in email and SMS marketing, lifecycle marketing, or CRM — ideally at a DTC-focused agency or in-house at an e-commerce brand. 
You're a Klaviyo power user — flows, segmentation, A/B testing, deliverability, and reporting are all in your toolkit. 
You're a strong copywriter who can adapt tone and voice across different brands and audiences. 
You think strategically about the customer journey and know how to use retention levers to drive LTV and reduce churn. 
You’re client-facing and comfortable - you can present a strategy and manage feedback without heavy direction. 
You're highly organized, self-managed, and used to owning multiple accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced environment. 
You have excellent written and verbal English — you communicate with clarity and confidence to both clients and internal stakeholders. 


You should apply if this sounds like you:


You have 3-5 years of experience in email/SMS marketing, growth marketing, or ecommerce CRM. 
You have agency experience or have worked on multiple client accounts simultaneously. 
You're a Klaviyo expert — and have the performance results to back it up. 
You've contributed to client relationships and can present strategy and data to senior stakeholders. 
You're proactive, creative, and hold yourself to a high standard without needing someone to push you. 
You're passionate about DTC, ecommerce, and the evolving landscape of lifecycle marketing. 


What It's Like to Work at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players who want to build something great. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics.


Unlimited PTO + Local holidays (Relevant to your hub): Rebooting is part of the work. Take the time you need to stay sharp. 
Remote-First Culture: Many roles are fully remote. Employees based in or near our New York or Lisbon HQs are expected to work hybrid with weekly in-office time. Hub locations include Brazil and Spain. 
Parental Leave: Flexible parental leave to support new parents during this important transition. 
Growth: Our interdisciplinary model gives every Darkroomer exposure far beyond their core role. Grow your skills, expand your influence, and stay at the forefront of the industry. 


Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Project Coordinator — Construction Operations & Client Proposals
description:
About the job

PROJECT COORDINATOR — HOME REMODELING & REPAIR OPERATIONS




Company: Constractiva

Location: Remote — Mexico (must work Pacific Time hours, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM PT)

Type: Full-time, independent contractor

Compensation: $2,000 – $2,500 USD per month, depending on experience

Reports to: Founder & CEO




———




THE SHORT VERSION




I'm a licensed contractor in Los Angeles specializing in home remodeling, repairs, and residential work orders. I'm looking for one person to own our project pipeline from the moment a client asks for something to the moment the work is scheduled and paid for.




Most of what we do is fast-moving: a bathroom remodel, a kitchen refresh, a repair work order, a punch list at a rental property. We handle a high volume of small-to-mid-size jobs, which means the pipeline is always full and always moving. That's why this role exists.




This is not a data entry job. You will decide what moves forward and what stalls. You'll write proposals that win work, chase the ones that go quiet, and make sure nothing sits untouched in a queue for a week. If you are the kind of person who cannot stand seeing an open item with no next step, this job will feel like it was written for you.




You'll also be one of the first users of a proposal platform we built ourselves — AI-assisted, photo-driven, designed to give clients pricing they can actually understand. Your job is to use it well and tell us how to make it better.




———




WHO WE ARE




Constractiva is a California-licensed General B contractor focused on home remodeling, residential repairs, and work orders across Los Angeles — bathrooms, kitchens, flooring, drywall, paint, and the steady stream of repair requests that come with managing residential property. We run real job sites and we build our own technology: a proposal platform that turns site photos and structured questions into transparent, itemized client pricing.




We are small, we move fast, and the person in this role will have more ownership in six months than most people get in three years somewhere larger.




———




WHAT YOU'LL OWN




THE PIPELINE (this is the core of the job)




You own the funnel and its conversion rate:




• New requests — respond same day, gather what's needed, get them moving

• Quotes — build proposals in our platform, send them out fast, make them clear

• Follow-up — when a quote goes quiet, you chase it. Day 3, day 7, day 14. You don't wait to be asked

• Approved work — coordinate with our field team to get it scheduled without gaps

• Invoicing — bill promptly and accurately when work completes

• Collections (first pass) — track what's outstanding and follow up until it's paid




You'll be measured on real numbers: how fast requests become quotes, what percentage of quotes get approved, how quickly approved work gets scheduled, and how fast we get paid.




PROPOSAL CREATION




• Use our AI-assisted platform to build itemized, transparent proposals from site photos and job details

• Ask the right follow-up questions — good proposals come from good inputs, and that's on you

• Review AI-generated output for accuracy before it reaches a client. You are the last set of eyes

• Communicate directly with clients about scope, options, and pricing




WORKING WITH OUR FIELD TEAM




Our maintenance coordinator is on job sites all day — recruiting, supervising, running crews. He cannot be in the admin system. That's you. You're his counterpart: he handles the ground, you handle everything else, and you sync daily so nothing falls between you.




PRODUCT FEEDBACK




You'll be in our platform every day. We want to know what's slow, what's confusing, what's missing. A few hours a week documenting that is part of the job, and it genuinely shapes what we build next.




———




WHO I'M LOOKING FOR




REQUIRED




• Residential construction or property maintenance background — you've worked for a remodeling contractor, a handyman or repair company, a property management maintenance team, a home warranty company, or in construction admin. You understand what a scope of work involves and roughly what things cost

• Fully bilingual, English and Spanish, written and spoken. You'll write client-facing proposals in English and talk to subcontractors in Spanish

• Genuinely comfortable with software — you learn new platforms quickly and don't need hand-holding

• Strong organizational discipline: you track dozens of open items without losing any

• Willing and able to follow up persistently. Some clients need to be pushed. That has to be okay with you

• Reliable high-speed internet, quiet work environment, and availability during Pacific Time business hours




WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT




• Experience with Jobber, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro, Buildertrend, AppFolio, or similar field service and property software

• Any experience writing or assembling repair and remodeling estimates or proposals

• Background in inside sales, client service, dispatch, or collections

About the job

Job Description: 

Our client is looking for an Tag Manager. This is a 3-month, project-based engagement to lead analytics and tracking implementation for a website rebuild on a modern content operations platform such as Sanity.io or similar.

The Tag Manager will own the GA4 and Google Tag Manager setup end to end, including defining tracking requirements, implementing tags and events, managing QA, and delivering documentation. This role also owns project management for the analytics workstream, coordinating with marketing, web, and engineering teams to ensure tracking is implemented correctly and ready for launch.

Forbes’ Fintech 50 list for nine consecutive years.

Visionary investors, persuaded by the economic power of the global majority, have committed half a billion dollars in equity and debt to Tala's success.

description:
About the job

About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $150M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a versatile and highly skilled Forward Deployed Engineer based in Mexico to join our team. In this role, you will combine strong technical abilities with excellent communication skills, working directly with customers to ensure they maximize the value of HappyRobot’s AI platform. You will be involved in onboarding, implementation, and ongoing support, while also contributing to product development and innovation.

At HappyRobot, there’s no role seniority or hierarchy — we operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You’ll Do


Customer-Facing Engineering – Work closely with customers from onboarding to ongoing usage, helping them integrate and optimize our AI solutions.
Technical Development – Build new features, MVPs, and scalable solutions that directly impact customer outcomes.
Full-Stack Development – Utilize React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Python to develop robust applications and tools.
AI/ML Applications – Design, implement, and iterate on AI/ML solutions, including LLM prompting, tuning of voices, and transcribers to optimize use cases.
Integration & APIs – Manage APIs and integrations with third-party systems to ensure seamless functionality for customers.
Cross-Functional Collaboration – Partner with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to deliver tailored solutions.
Iterative Problem-Solving – Continuously iterate and improve AI solutions based on customer feedback and evolving requirements.
Project Management – Prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines while maintaining high-quality results.


Must Have


Strong full-stack experience: React, TypeScript, Node.js.
Hands-on proficiency in Python.
Experience building AI/ML applications, including LLM prompting and tuning.
Ability to manage APIs and integrate with third-party systems.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Proven ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects under tight deadlines.
Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.


Why join us?


Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.
Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.
Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.
Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.
Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.


Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

About the job

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid

This is a remote/hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Clari + Salesloft, our Senior Data Scientists will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Data Science team, taking full ownership of projects that redefine how sellers work and drive revenue. We believe that the most innovative products have a passionate and supportive research team behind them.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for exploring and applying the latest advances in AI to solve real-world challenges for our customers. Specifically, you will:


Apply your expertise in agentic systems, NLP, and machine learning to build solutions that enhance the productivity and effectiveness of sales professionals.
Design and run robust experiments, translating ambiguous problems into concrete research questions and prototypes.
Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering teams to ensure your research paves a clear path to production and delivers value to our users.
Act as a thought leader and subject matter expert, identifying new opportunities for innovation and influencing the direction of our AI roadmap.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to build revolutionary AI and ML systems that are changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, deeply curious, and strategic researcher who is passionate about owning their work and its impact. You are a leader and mentor who thrives on identifying gaps in knowledge and charting new paths for innovation. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI for sales by taking ownership of complex projects and seeing them through to completion.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Scientist is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Clari + Salesloft Data Science team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming Data Scientists who are all aligned on one vision and mission:


Vision: Fundamentally transform the way buyers and sellers drive repeatable outcomes
Mission: Bring science to the art of sales 


The Data Science team consists of collaborative and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about their craft. We operate in a dynamic environment where our project timelines more closely align with engineering sprints than academic papers. We value intellectual curiosity and encourage researchers to voice feedback and help prioritize projects that will have the biggest impact.

THE SKILL SET:


5+ years of overall experience as an AI Researcher, Data Scientist, or ML Engineer
1+ years of experience with deploying ML/AI features in production

About the job

About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

About You

You’re a connector who puts people first and values the lasting partnerships you’ll build. You’re an active listener who cares about the stories people share and are energized by communication and collaboration. You love learning new things and are known for bringing innovative perspectives and questions to the table. You’re deadline and results-driven, passionate about creating new processes, systems, and best practices that help your internal partners do their best work.

About This Role

As a Senior Customer Experience Analyst, you will split your time between resolving complex or specialized customer escalations and driving individual or team projects across the following operational areas: vendor management, content/wiki management, operational readiness, operational excellence and process development, and data analysis and insights.

Because our frontline associates resolve the vast majority of customer requests, escalations by definition require critical thinking, thoughtfulness, and a gentle touch. That’s where you come in! Your work as the final level of support escalation will involve managing and prioritizing multiple requests at once, communicating with customers directly to gather information or share outcomes, offering assistance to our Tier 1 and Tier 2 support associates, and often coordinating on complex resolutions with cross-functional teams. On the project side, your end-to-end ownership will encompass planning and coordination through implementation, and the validation of impact or identification of additional follow-up work. You will become familiar with all aspects of our team’s operations, but we are particularly interested in candidates with a background and interest in content/wiki management or data analysis and insights.

This position offers an opportunity for professional growth through managing impactful projects and mentoring junior team members, and your contributions to larger organization-wide will give you exposure to a range of cross-functional teams including Customer Success, Internal Escalations, Product/Engineering, Tax, Revenue Operations, Legal, and more.

What You’ll Be Doing

Customer escalations


Resolving sensitive and complex escalations with empathy, thoughtfulness, tact, sound judgment, clear communication, and minimal oversight. 
Identifying and escalating significant customer experience changes that affect our customers or business operations (e.g. outages or software failures, changes in sentiment, issue trends). 
Collaborating cross-functionally via Slack, Zoom, and in-person to gather information, summarize findings, and resolve issues. 
Providing guidance and coaching to our frontline support associates when they request assistance. 
Developing subject matter expertise on Udemy Business’s products, customers, support processes, and internal cross-functional partnerships. 


Operational work


Proposing and driving operational improvement projects from planning through implementation, monitoring, and reporting outcomes. 
Proactively communicating project updates, blockers, or improvement opportunities to stakeholders, and leverage available resources – including data, tooling, documentation, and peer/cross-functional stakeholders – to develop insights and drive outcomes. 
Contributing to broader organizational and cross-functional initiatives. 


What you’ll have: 


Proven experience resolving complex customer issues with minimal oversight, preferably as part of a global team within a hybrid workplace model. 
A track record of identifying and seizing opportunities to uplevel the customer experience via process improvements and cross-functional recommendations. 
The desire to balance self-sufficiency, ownership, and accountability with teamwork and collaboration. 
Nice to have – Experience working with any of the following systems or tools: Service Cloud, Zendesk, Atlassian (Jira and Confluence), Asana, Tableau, UnitQ, Salesforce, and Stripe

Complex Issue Resolution: You are skilled at managing sensitive, intricate escalations independently, using empathy, judgment, and tact to find solutions. Project and Process Management: You lead projects end-to-end, from planning through implementation, continuously improving processes and enhancing team efficiency. You prioritize effectively, balancing multiple projects and initiatives with a focus on quality, efficiency, and impactful outcomes. And you are comfortable working with autonomy and ambiguity. 
Data-Driven Decision Making: You leverage tools, data, insights, and cross-functional relationships to make informed decisions and meaningful recommendations. Resourceful and analytical, you use available resources to track outcomes and identify opportunities for improvement, particularly in areas like content management, prompt engineering, and operational insights. 
Adaptable and Strategic Communication: You communicate clearly and effectively across all levels, from customer interactions to executive updates, and can adapt your style to various audiences. Strong in relationship-building, you respectfully challenge ideas, reach compromises, and support team members through mentorship and guidance. 


We understand that not everyone will match each of the above qualifications. However, we also realize that everyone has unique experiences that can add value to our company. Even if you think your background might not perfectly align, we'd love to hear from you!

Why work here?

Learning is part of the job. You’ll get full access to Udemy courses, a monthly UDay to invest in yourself, and a budget to spend on whatever helps you improve. Many people are diving into AI lately, but what you focus on is up to you.

description:
About the job

About PostPilot

PostPilot helps ecommerce and consumer brands turn direct mail into a modern performance marketing channel.




Our platform makes it easy for brands to send individually personalized postcards to customers and prospects, combining the targeting and measurability of digital marketing with the attention and trust of physical mail.




At a time when customers are overwhelmed by digital ads, inboxes are crowded, and online channels keep getting more expensive, direct mail gives brands a different way to reach people and drive growth.




We're a fast-growing team working with leading brands across ecommerce, retail, health and wellness, apparel, beauty, home, and more. Our team is practical, creative, and focused on helping customers launch campaigns that actually perform.




About The Role

We're looking for a Graphic Designer to help customers bring direct mail campaigns to life.




This is a hands-on, customer-facing design role focused on postcard campaigns for ecommerce and consumer brands. You'll design postcard campaigns for a wide range of brands, adapt customer assets into effective direct mail creative, help improve offers and CTAs, prepare files for print, and work with customers and internal teams to get campaigns launched quickly and cleanly.




This is a high-volume creative environment, but not a repetitive one. You'll work across many different brands, industries, offers, and campaign types, often with several projects moving at once. The role is best for someone who enjoys variety, clear deadlines, practical iteration, and the rhythm of getting good work out the door consistently.




Customer conversations are part of the role. You should be comfortable joining customer calls to clarify briefs, discuss creative feedback, explain design decisions, and help align on campaign direction. This is not a sales role, but it is a customer-facing creative role.




The right person is not just a strong visual designer. You're also comfortable thinking through the marketing goal behind a campaign, communicating with customers, working across many projects at once, and using AI tools thoughtfully to move faster without giving up taste, judgment, or attention to detail.




This is a full-time remote position. The role requires availability during US business hours.




What You'll Do

Design postcard campaigns for PostPilot customers across a wide range of industries and brand styles.
Turn customer-provided assets, copy, offers, and briefs into polished, print-ready direct mail creative.
Advise customers and internal account teams on creative direction, messaging, offers, CTAs, layout, and campaign strategy.
Join customer calls to clarify campaign goals, discuss creative direction, review feedback, explain design decisions, and help customers move toward a strong final campaign.
Review designs for direct mail and print readiness, including hierarchy, legibility, bleed, trim, safe areas, mail panel constraints, QR codes, URLs, offer clarity, and front/back consistency.
Communicate with customers and internal teams to answer design-related questions, clarify briefs, collect missing assets, and resolve feedback.
Manage a steady queue of design requests while meeting draft deadlines and keeping work organized.
Use AI tools in your daily workflow to speed up ideation, versioning, copy refinement, research, organization, and QA while maintaining strong creative judgment.




About You

You're a strong designer who understands that great marketing creative has to look good, communicate clearly, and drive action.




You can move quickly without being sloppy. You know how to adapt to different brand styles. You can take imperfect customer inputs and turn them into something clear, polished, and effective. You are comfortable asking good questions, explaining your thinking, and working through feedback from customers and teammates.




You do not need to know everything about direct mail on day one. We do expect strong design fundamentals, good marketing instincts, clear communication, comfort with AI tools, and a willingness to learn the details of print, production, and campaign strategy.




Must Have

Strong visual design skills and a portfolio showing polished, commercially useful work.
Fluency in Adobe Creative Suite.
Experience designing for marketing, advertising, ecommerce, DTC brands, or other performance-driven creative.
Strong layout, typography, hierarchy, and brand adaptation skills.

description:
About the job

Reports to: Creative Director Anna Sarelly (Showrunner)

Works closely with: CMO, Brand Social, Creative Studio, external production partners

Location: Mexico City

Type: Full-time

Experience: 3+ years




THE ROLE

SARELLY is a cultural-first beauty brand born in Mexico and built for the next generation of Latinas. We’re now building Entertainment into a core pillar of the brand.

At the center is Drama en la Chamba, our original entertainment franchise, with ambitions to expand across episodic storytelling, YouTube, social content and future original IP.

We are looking for an Entertainment Studio Producer to turn our Founder & Showrunner’s creative vision into a consistently produced, distributed and growing entertainment engine.

You will own the day-to-day machinery behind SARELLY Entertainment: taking ideas from concept through production, post-production and distribution, while building the systems required to deliver consistently.

You will also turn every hero production into a broader stream of platform-native storytelling that keeps audiences engaged between episodes and seasons.

The goal is simple: enable the Showrunner to focus on vision, storytelling, characters and creative direction—not production management, editing workflows or publishing logistics.

This is neither a traditional TV producer nor social media role. We need someone who understands both sides of modern entertainment: producing a show and programming it for a YouTube-first, digital-native audience.




ABOUT SARELLY

SARELLY is a fast-growing beauty brand born in Mexico, founded by creator Anna Sarelly and beauty executive Rémi Martini.

Since launching beauty in 2023, SARELLY has rapidly expanded across DTC and leading retailers in Mexico and the U.S. In 2026, the brand was named Breakthrough Brand of the Year at The Business of Beauty Global Awards and is launching nationwide at Target.

Our ambition is to build one of the most culturally relevant beauty brands to emerge from Latin America.




WHAT YOU’LL DO01 — RUN ENTERTAINMENT PRODUCTION

Own end-to-end production for Drama en la Chamba and future original formats.

You will:

Own the Entertainment production calendar and priorities
Translate the Showrunner’s vision into production plans, briefs, timelines and deliverables
Coordinate scripts, pre-production, shoots, post-production and final delivery
Manage production companies, agencies, editors, freelancers and other partners
Own budgets and production economics, including cost per episode or format
Manage schedules, resources, feedback rounds and approvals
Ensure projects are delivered on time, on budget and at the expected creative standard
Identify production risks early and recommend solutions
Build clear production workflows and approval processes
Assess capacity and recommend external or internal resources as the vertical grows
Prepare decisions, consolidate feedback and independently resolve day-to-day execution issues within established creative direction




A major measure of success is Showrunner leverage: Anna should spend significantly more time on vision, story, characters and major creative decisions—and less on production management and execution.




This is a hands-on role. You should be senior enough to build the operating model and manage partners, while comfortable getting into the details required to make the work happen.




02 — BUILD THE CONTENT MULTIPLICATION ENGINE

Build a repeatable system that transforms every hero production into a broader stream of content that extends the story and grows the audience.




Formats may include:

Trailers, teasers and recaps
Character edits and spotlights
Behind-the-scenes and cast reactions
Best moments and plot-twist edits
Shorts and platform-native cutdowns
Extended scenes and community-driven content

You will define how derivative content is planned, produced and delivered with editors, freelancers and production partners.




AI should be integral to how you work. Use AI-powered creative and editing tools to identify high-potential moments, accelerate repurposing and increase the speed and volume of content without compromising quality. Continuously test emerging tools and integrate the best into the Studio workflow.




03 — OWN ENTERTAINMENT PROGRAMMING & YOUTUBE

Own and develop SARELLY’s Entertainment YouTube channel as the dedicated home of SARELLY Entertainment.

You will:

Build and manage the Entertainment editorial calendar
Define programming cadence around episodes, seasons and key moments
Package and sequence hero and derivative content for YouTube
Oversee publishing and channel development
Optimize titles, thumbnails, formats, runtime and release cadence
Analyze watch time, completion, returning viewership and other audience signals
Use performance learnings to inform programming and production
Recommend how Entertainment extends across TikTok and Instagram
Partner with Brand Social to integrate Entertainment into SARELLY’s broader social calendar




This role owns the Entertainment programming stream and SARELLY Entertainment YouTube channel, not SARELLY’s overall social media calendar.




THE PERSON WE’RE LOOKING FOR

You are first and foremost a producer and operator who understands YouTube-native entertainment.




You know how to take a creative vision and build the people, process, budget and production rhythm required to deliver it consistently.




You have personally worked on content produced for YouTube and understand how format, cadence, packaging, audience behavior and iteration differ from traditional production.




Your background may come from YouTube-first entertainment, creator-led media, serialized digital content, digital publishing or a modern entertainment studio.




Traditional production experience alone is not enough. Social media expertise alone is not enough. We want someone who has actually made entertainment for digital audiences and turned creative ambition into a repeatable production operation.




WHAT MATTERS MOST

The strongest candidates will have:

Produced recurring or serialized YouTube content on a consistent publishing schedule
Experience with seasons, episodes and recurring formats—not only campaigns
Strong end-to-end production experience from development through final delivery
An AI-native mindset, constantly experimenting with tools to increase creative possibilities, speed and output
Experience owning production budgets and economics
Managed production companies, agencies, editors, freelancers and other partners
Built production workflows or systems where none existed
Strong understanding of YouTube programming and performance metrics, including packaging, cadence, retention and viewership
Strong understanding of TikTok and Instagram ecosystems
Experience turning episodic content into short-form and platform-native formats
Strong editorial judgment and storytelling instincts
The judgment to protect a creative founder’s vision without needing to be the author of it
Excellent project-management skills and confidence making day-to-day decisions independently
Strong understanding of Latino audiences, culture and entertainment
Professional proficiency in Spanish and English




HOW WE’LL MEASURE SUCCESS
Production excellence: Projects are consistently delivered on time, on budget and at the expected creative standard.
Showrunner leverage: Anna focuses on creative vision and major decisions rather than production execution.
YouTube growth: SARELLY builds a distinctive, consistently programmed Entertainment destination with growing watch time, returning viewership and engagement.
Content multiplication: Every hero production generates a strong stream of derivative, platform-native storytelling.
Audience development: Audience behavior and performance data increasingly inform programming and production.
Operational excellence: Workflows become clearer, faster and less dependent on individuals.
Production economics: Clear visibility into costs and resource requirements by episode and format.
Entertainment scalability: A repeatable engine supports Drama en la Chamba and future original IP.




HOW YOU’LL WORK WITH THE REST OF SARELLY

Founder & CCO / Showrunner — Anna Sarelly

Owns creative vision, storytelling universe, characters and creative direction.




CMO / Entertainment Strategy & Growth

Owns Entertainment’s broader brand and business growth strategy, including GTM, distribution partnerships, collaborations, retail integrations and commercialization.




Entertainment Studio Producer — You

Owns the production engine, post-production, Entertainment programming and YouTube channel.




Brand Social Manager

Owns overall social strategy, master calendar and brand channels. Entertainment programming is integrated into this calendar.




Creative Studio / Associate Art Director

Protects SARELLY’s overall visual identity and brand creative standards.




WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT OWN

This role does not own SARELLY’s overall social strategy, master social calendar, day-to-day brand/product content, global creative direction, product-launch GTM, commercial partnerships, distribution negotiations or retail activation strategy.




Your primary accountability is clear:

Build and run the Entertainment production and YouTube programming engine that turns SARELLY’s creative vision into scalable original entertainment.

description:
About the job

Brand Manager – Teamfight Tactics 

Brand Management at Riot is focused on players and fans. Our mission is to make it better to be a player by building trust, inspiring fandom, and creating meaningful experiences across every touchpoint. For Teamfight Tactics, this means celebrating the strategy, creativity, and competitive mastery at the heart of the game while growing a passionate global community around it.

As a Brand Manager II for Teamfight Tactics, you will primarily lead publishing and brand marketing efforts for TFT Esports (approx. 80% of your scope) while supporting broader TFT publishing initiatives and evergreen brand priorities (approx. 20%). You'll help strengthen TFT's competitive identity through integrated campaigns, compelling storytelling, and player-first experiences that celebrate the game's global esports ecosystem. 80% Esports / 20% Game

This is a highly collaborative role that works across Creative, Communications, Social, Regional Publishing, Esports Product, Broadcast, Community, and Production teams to deliver impactful campaigns that grow fandom and support business outcomes.

You will report to the Senior Manager, Brand Marketing and this role can be based in Mexico city or LAX.

Responsibilities

Brand Strategy & Campaign Leadership


Steward the TFT Esports brand by developing marketing and communications strategies that strengthen its competitive identity and deepen player fandom.
Lead integrated global marketing campaigns for esports events, tournaments, and competitive moments, from brief through launch, measurement, and retrospective.
Translate player and audience insights into compelling creative briefs, campaign strategies, and marketing plans.
Support broader TFT publishing initiatives throughout the year, contributing to game campaigns and evergreen brand priorities beyond the esports calendar.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Global Publishing


Partner with Esports Product, Broadcast, Competitive Operations, Social, Community, Influencer, and Regional Publishing teams to develop aligned global marketing plans.
Partner with regional publishing teams by providing creative frameworks, marketing assets, and best practices that enable locally relevant execution while maintaining global brand consistency.
Collaborate with Insights, Business Development, Product, and Live Experiences teams to identify opportunities that strengthen the TFT player experience and esports ecosystem.


Creative & Operational Excellence


Steward creative development across esports marketing initiatives, ensuring work reflects TFT's brand, competitive spirit, and player experience.
Manage campaign timelines, budgets, agency relationships, and production partners to deliver high-quality work that is on strategy, on time, and on budget.
Stay closely connected to the TFT community, competitive scene, and broader gaming landscape to identify emerging opportunities and inform future marketing initiatives.


Required Qualifications


3 to 5 years of experience in brand management, product marketing, community marketing, or agency roles within gaming, entertainment, or esports.
Deep understanding of the TFT esports landscape and a nuanced grasp of the players, fans, creators, and communities that shape its competitive ecosystem.
Experience developing and executing integrated marketing and communications campaigns from planning through launch.
Strong understanding of brand fundamentals and experience translating player or audience insights into effective marketing strategies.
Experience working with gaming audiences, live events, or community-driven marketing initiatives.
Experience collaborating across cross-functional and international teams to deliver shared goals.
Experience working with agencies, creative partners, or production teams to bring campaigns to life.
Experience using campaign performance data and audience insights to evaluate campaign performance and optimize future marketing efforts.
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.


Desired Qualifications


Familiarity with Teamfight Tactics, Riot Games' portfolio, or competitive strategy games.
Experience partnering with esports product, broadcast, live event production, or game development teams.
Understanding of creative production workflows and integrated global marketing campaigns.
Awareness of emerging trends across gaming, entertainment, sports, and lifestyle marketing.
Active TFT player and engaged member of the TFT community.


You have strong marketing instincts, enjoy collaborating across disciplines, and care deeply about creating campaigns that resonate with players and fans. You balance creativity with thoughtful execution and are motivated by delivering experiences that strengthen TFT's competitive identity and long-term fandom.

For this role, you'll find success through craft expertise, a collaborative spirit, and decision-making that prioritizes the delight of players. We will be looking at your past studies, experience, and your personal relationship with games. If you embody player empathy and care about players' experiences, this could be your role!

Our Perks

Perks: Riot focuses on work/life balance, shown by our open paid time off policy and other perks such as flexible work schedules. We offer medical, dental, and life insurance, parental leave for you, your spouse/domestic partner, and children, and a 401k/Private Pension Plan with company match. Check out our benefits pages for more information.

At Riot Games, we put players first. That mission drives every decision in our quest to create games and experiences that make it better to be a player. Whether you’re working directly on a new player-facing experience or you’re supporting the company as a whole, everyone at Riot is part of our mission. And just like in our games, we’re better when we work together. Our goal is to create collaborative teams where you are empowered to bring your unique perspective everyday. If that sounds like the kind of place you want to work, we’re looking forward to your application.

It’s our policy to provide equal employment opportunity for all applicants and members of Riot Games, Inc. Riot Games makes reasonable accommodations for handicapped and disabled Rioters and does not unlawfully discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, handicap, veteran status, marital status, criminal history, or any other category protected by applicable federal and state law. We consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state and local law, including the California Fair Chance Act, the City of Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the Washington Fair Chance Act.

Duties

Per the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the following core duties may create a basis for disqualifying candidates with relevant criminal histories:


Safeguarding confidential and sensitive Company data
Communication with others, including Rioters and third parties such as vendors, and/or players, including minors
Accessing Company assets, secure digital systems, and networks
Ensuring a safe interactive environment for players and other Rioters


These duties are directly related to essential operations, safety, trust, and compliance obligations within our organization. Please note that job duties may evolve based on business needs and additional responsibilities may be assigned as necessary to maintain operational efficiency and security.

description:
About the job

🇵🇭 USD 8,000 to USD 10,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in the Philippines!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard working hours for this role are Tuesday to Saturday, approximately 6:00am–3:00pm or 7:00am–4:00pm Philippine Time, depending on US daylight saving time. These hours correspond to Monday to Friday, 3:00pm–12:00 midnight Pacific Time.




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 

We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.




The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within the Philippines.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

description:
About the job

Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Guadalajara, Mexico, Hybrid

This is a remote/hybrid position, which will require the ability to be onsite in our Guadalajara, Mexico office as needed. Candidates must be based in Guadalajara.

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Clari + Salesloft, our Data Scientists are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing data science team and will conduct innovative machine learning research and build product feature prototypes that will deliver value to our customers.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for solving business problems using our in-house data and your technical prowess. Specifically, you will:


Apply advanced statistical techniques and concepts to analyze data from the company databases and other unstructured data sources to build innovative product features, marketing content, and internal services.
Invest in the sales engagement domain; collaborate with product, engineering, sales, customer success, and other teams to understand business and customer needs, and translate them to tangible data science problems.
Own and manage complex projects and communicate effectively with stakeholders.
Contribute to the rapid growth of the research organization, being flexible in data engineering, algorithmist, and analyst responsibilities as they arise.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to build revolutionary AI and ML systems that are changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a results-oriented, deeply curious, and strategic researcher who is passionate about owning their work and its impact. You are a leader and mentor who thrives on identifying gaps in knowledge and charting new paths for innovation. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us push the boundaries of what's possible in AI for sales by taking ownership of complex projects and seeing them through to completion.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Scientist is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Clari + Salesloft Data Science team is comprised of seasoned and up-and-coming Data Scientists who are all aligned on one vision and mission:


Vision: Fundamentally transform the way buyers and sellers drive repeatable outcomes
Mission: Bring science to the art of sales 


The Data Science team consists of collaborative and self-motivated individuals who are passionate about their craft. We operate in a dynamic environment where our project timelines more closely align with engineering sprints than academic papers. We value intellectual curiosity and encourage researchers to voice feedback and help prioritize projects that will have the biggest impact.

THE SKILL SET:


2+ years of experience as an AI Researcher, Data Scientist, or ML Engineer.
Experience delivering components of research projects, from experimental design to implementing models.
Strong proficiency in AI agent systems, Natural Language Processing (NLP), and classic machine learning methodologies.
A collaborative spirit with a passion for sharing knowledge with your peers.
Experience turning research findings into actionable insights for technical partners.
Excellent communication skills; you must be able to articulate complex technical concepts
familiarity with python for data processing, ML, AI agents
familiarity with frameworks for agentic AI (LangGraph, Google ADK, Open AI Agents SDK etc)


At Clari + Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.

We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.

If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team. Explore our open roles and consider joining us!

Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Clari + Salesloft will come from an @clari.com or @ salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Clari + Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. To verify the authenticity of any job-related communication, please visit our official Careers Page.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, notetaking, or summarizing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment — all hiring decisions are made by people. If you would like more information about how your data is processed or prefer to opt out of any AI-assisted tools, please let your recruiter know. Opting out will not impact your experience or consideration.

title: Customer Success Specialist

Acordar con el cliente el alcance, los entregables y las fechas comprometidas de cada implementación, y responder por su cumplimiento.
Ejecutar y mantener los checklists de onboarding, asegurando que cada etapa avance en tiempo y forma.
Identificar riesgos y bloqueos del proyecto, proponer alternativas y escalar oportunamente cuando comprometan la fecha de salida.
Mantener actualizados los tableros, trackers y herramientas de seguimiento del área, incluido el de salud del cliente (customer health).
Coordinar la activación y el seguimiento del piloto, midiendo la adopción real de los usuarios antes del go-live.
Apoyar en la presentación de demos comerciales cuando se requiera.
Analizar y registrar insights, mejoras y bugs detectados durante las demos y la activación de pilotos.
Liderar la limpieza, migración y reconciliación de datos de clientes: definición del mapeo, corrección de archivos, detección de duplicados y carga a las plantillas del sistema.
Configurar la plataforma de acuerdo con los procesos operativos de cada cliente: catálogos, usuarios, permisos, plantillas y flujos documentales.
Validar la carga inicial de información (clientes, embarques y catálogos) y obtener la conformidad del cliente antes del arranque.
Levantar y documentar los requerimientos de integración con sistemas externos (contabilidad, ERP, portales u otros), coordinando con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología.
Analizar discrepancias y hallazgos de la migración, proponer la corrección correspondiente y escalar los casos críticos.
Traducir las necesidades del cliente en requerimientos funcionales claros para el equipo de Producto, a partir de reuniones, mockups y transcripciones.
Documentar procesos, acuerdos, configuraciones e incidencias de cada implementación, dejando trazabilidad de las decisiones tomadas.
Crear y mantener material de apoyo para el área de Customer Success: manuales, guías rápidas, FAQ y documentación operativa.
Dar seguimiento a los requerimientos levantados hasta su liberación y comunicar los avances al cliente.
Ser el punto de contacto principal del cliente durante la implementación y el acompañamiento posterior.
Conducir sesiones con el cliente —kickoff, capacitaciones, revisiones de avance y cierres de proyecto— y registrar acuerdos y próximos pasos.
Atender dudas, tickets y solicitudes cumpliendo los tiempos de respuesta acordados, y escalar cuando corresponda.
Redactar comunicaciones profesionales con clientes: correos de seguimiento, avisos, minutas y reportes de avance.
Detectar oportunidades de expansión (nuevos módulos, usuarios o procesos) y compartirlas con el equipo comercial y de producto.
Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Operaciones, Producto, Growth y Ventas.
Representar la voz del cliente en las discusiones de producto, con evidencia y prioridad de negocio.
Desbloquear pendientes internos y dar seguimiento a los compromisos adquiridos entre áreas.
Documentar y mejorar los playbooks, plantillas y procesos del área de onboarding.
Analizar las incidencias recurrentes, identificar su causa raíz y proponer acciones para prevenirlas.
Proponer e implementar mejoras que reduzcan el tiempo de implementación y el esfuerzo manual del equipo.
Compartir los aprendizajes de cada implementación con el resto del equipo.
Contribuir a la base de conocimiento interna de Customer Success.

Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Logística, Cadena de Suministro, Relaciones Comerciales, Negocios Internacionales, Comercio Internacional, Gestión Empresarial, Administración de Operaciones o Ingeniería en Sistemas.
De 2 a 4 años en Customer Success, implementación, onboarding, soporte a clientes u operaciones, en empresas SaaS B2B o en la industria logística orientada a la tecnología.
Experiencia comprobable gestionando clientes de forma directa y liderando proyectos con varios involucrados.
Experiencia trabajando con datos de clientes: limpieza, mapeo, validación y carga de archivos.
Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado: tablas dinámicas, BUSCARV/XLOOKUP y transformación de archivos CSV.
Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams)
Herramientas de documentación y gestión de proyectos como Notion y Jira.
Nociones de integraciones entre sistemas (APIs, layouts y archivos de intercambio) y capacidad para dialogar con equipos técnicos.
Redacción de documentación funcional y comunicación escrita profesional.
Facilidad para aprender nuevas plataformas con rapidez.
Español nativo.
Inglés intermedio (B2 o superior) para comunicación escrita con clientes y manejo de documentación y terminología del sector.
Autonomía y ownership: dar seguimiento hasta cerrar.
Organización para gestionar varias implementaciones en paralelo.
Pensamiento analítico y atención al detalle.
Comunicación clara con perfiles operativos y directivos.
Manejo de conversaciones difíciles: expectativas, retrasos y escalamientos.
Priorización y gestión del tiempo en múltiples frentes.
Orientación al cliente y a resultados.
Trabajo colaborativo y adaptabilidad.
Conocimiento de la industria de freight forwarding, comercio exterior, aduanas o cadena de suministro.
Familiaridad con documentos de carga (HAWB/MAWB, cotizaciones, facturación y documentos de cumplimiento).
Experiencia implementando TMS, ERP, WMS u otras plataformas operativas.
