description:
About the job

Acerca de nosotros

MagicLog es una LogTech que empodera a los freight forwarders para evolucionar sus negocios mediante la digitalización. Nuestra misión es habilitar operaciones ágiles y decisiones estratégicas impulsadas por IA, transformando soluciones complejas en plataformas intuitivas diseñadas por expertos en logística. Simplificamos la adopción tecnológica y reducimos costos operativos para impulsar el crecimiento de la industria logística en LATAM.




Tu misión

Como Customer Success Specialist (Operations) serás responsable de que un portafolio de clientes complete una implementación exitosa y alcance valor real con la plataforma. Serás el punto de contacto principal durante el onboarding y el acompañamiento posterior, liderando cada proyecto de principio a fin dentro de un entorno B2B técnico y de industria especializada.

El rol combina tres dimensiones que definen a nuestro equipo: la gestión del onboarding de nuevos clientes, el soporte y la retención de los clientes actuales, y el análisis y entendimiento de la plataforma para apoyar a los equipos comercial, de producto y de tecnología en su evolución. En el día a día serás dueño del plan de trabajo, de los acuerdos con el cliente y de los pendientes internos necesarios para que el proyecto llegue a go-live en tiempo y con la calidad esperada.

Es una posición de ejecución y ownership: no solo das seguimiento, sino que tomas decisiones sobre cómo configurar, documentar y desbloquear cada implementación, y escalas únicamente lo que realmente lo requiere.

Este rol es ideal para profesionales con experiencia en implementación, soporte u operaciones en entornos SaaS o logísticos, que disfruten resolver problemas técnicos junto al cliente y quieran crecer dentro de una empresa en expansión. Reportarás al Customer Success Lead y trabajarás en un esquema completamente remoto.




Responsabilidades principales

Implementación y onboarding

Liderar el ciclo completo de implementación de nuevos clientes: onboarding, configuración, go-live y estabilización.
Acordar con el cliente el alcance, los entregables y las fechas comprometidas de cada implementación, y responder por su cumplimiento.
Ejecutar y mantener los checklists de onboarding, asegurando que cada etapa avance en tiempo y forma.
Identificar riesgos y bloqueos del proyecto, proponer alternativas y escalar oportunamente cuando comprometan la fecha de salida.
Mantener actualizados los tableros, trackers y herramientas de seguimiento del área, incluido el de salud del cliente (customer health).

Soporte preventa (comercial y producto)

Coordinar la activación y el seguimiento del piloto, midiendo la adopción real de los usuarios antes del go-live.
Apoyar en la presentación de demos comerciales cuando se requiera.
Analizar y registrar insights, mejoras y bugs detectados durante las demos y la activación de pilotos.

Datos, configuración e integraciones

Liderar la limpieza, migración y reconciliación de datos de clientes: definición del mapeo, corrección de archivos, detección de duplicados y carga a las plantillas del sistema.
Configurar la plataforma de acuerdo con los procesos operativos de cada cliente: catálogos, usuarios, permisos, plantillas y flujos documentales.
Validar la carga inicial de información (clientes, embarques y catálogos) y obtener la conformidad del cliente antes del arranque.
Levantar y documentar los requerimientos de integración con sistemas externos (contabilidad, ERP, portales u otros), coordinando con los equipos de Producto y Tecnología.
Analizar discrepancias y hallazgos de la migración, proponer la corrección correspondiente y escalar los casos críticos.

Documentación y requerimientos de producto

Traducir las necesidades del cliente en requerimientos funcionales claros para el equipo de Producto, a partir de reuniones, mockups y transcripciones.
Documentar procesos, acuerdos, configuraciones e incidencias de cada implementación, dejando trazabilidad de las decisiones tomadas.
Crear y mantener material de apoyo para el área de Customer Success: manuales, guías rápidas, FAQ y documentación operativa.
Dar seguimiento a los requerimientos levantados hasta su liberación y comunicar los avances al cliente.

Gestión de la relación y adopción

Ser el punto de contacto principal del cliente durante la implementación y el acompañamiento posterior.
Conducir sesiones con el cliente —kickoff, capacitaciones, revisiones de avance y cierres de proyecto— y registrar acuerdos y próximos pasos.
Atender dudas, tickets y solicitudes cumpliendo los tiempos de respuesta acordados, y escalar cuando corresponda.
Redactar comunicaciones profesionales con clientes: correos de seguimiento, avisos, minutas y reportes de avance.
Detectar oportunidades de expansión (nuevos módulos, usuarios o procesos) y compartirlas con el equipo comercial y de producto.

Colaboración interfuncional

Trabajar de manera cercana con los equipos de Operaciones, Producto, Growth y Ventas.
Representar la voz del cliente en las discusiones de producto, con evidencia y prioridad de negocio.
Desbloquear pendientes internos y dar seguimiento a los compromisos adquiridos entre áreas.

Calidad y mejora continua

Documentar y mejorar los playbooks, plantillas y procesos del área de onboarding.
Analizar las incidencias recurrentes, identificar su causa raíz y proponer acciones para prevenirlas.
Proponer e implementar mejoras que reduzcan el tiempo de implementación y el esfuerzo manual del equipo.

Habilitación del equipo

Compartir los aprendizajes de cada implementación con el resto del equipo.
Contribuir a la base de conocimiento interna de Customer Success.




Lo que buscamos (Must have)

Formación

Licenciatura o ingeniería concluida (o pasante con experiencia comprobable) en carreras como:

Administración de Empresas, Ingeniería Industrial, Ingeniería en Logística, Cadena de Suministro, Relaciones Comerciales, Negocios Internacionales, Comercio Internacional, Gestión Empresarial, Administración de Operaciones o Ingeniería en Sistemas.

También valoraremos perfiles de otras carreras que demuestren experiencia y competencias alineadas con la posición.

Experiencia

De 2 a 4 años en Customer Success, implementación, onboarding, soporte a clientes u operaciones, en empresas SaaS B2B o en la industria logística orientada a la tecnología.
Experiencia comprobable gestionando clientes de forma directa y liderando proyectos con varios involucrados.
Experiencia trabajando con datos de clientes: limpieza, mapeo, validación y carga de archivos.

Conocimientos técnicos

Excel a nivel intermedio-avanzado: tablas dinámicas, BUSCARV/XLOOKUP y transformación de archivos CSV.
Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Teams)
Herramientas de documentación y gestión de proyectos como Notion y Jira.
Nociones de integraciones entre sistemas (APIs, layouts y archivos de intercambio) y capacidad para dialogar con equipos técnicos.
Redacción de documentación funcional y comunicación escrita profesional.
Facilidad para aprender nuevas plataformas con rapidez.

Idiomas

Español nativo.
Inglés intermedio (B2 o superior) para comunicación escrita con clientes y manejo de documentación y terminología del sector.

Habilidades

Buscamos personas que destaquen por:

Autonomía y ownership: dar seguimiento hasta cerrar.
Organización para gestionar varias implementaciones en paralelo.
Pensamiento analítico y atención al detalle.
Comunicación clara con perfiles operativos y directivos.
Manejo de conversaciones difíciles: expectativas, retrasos y escalamientos.
Priorización y gestión del tiempo en múltiples frentes.
Orientación al cliente y a resultados.
Trabajo colaborativo y adaptabilidad.

Deseable (no indispensable)

Conocimiento de la industria de freight forwarding, comercio exterior, aduanas o cadena de suministro.
Familiaridad con documentos de carga (HAWB/MAWB, cotizaciones, facturación y documentos de cumplimiento).
Experiencia implementando TMS, ERP, WMS u otras plataformas operativas.
Nociones de SQL, análisis de datos o herramientas de BI.
Manejo de herramientas de IA (como Claude, ChatGPT u otros asistentes) para agilizar tareas de documentación, redacción, análisis de datos y resolución de problemas; valoramos saber estructurar buenos prompts y aprovechar la IA de forma crítica y productiva.

Qué buscamos en la persona

Que haga las preguntas correctas y no tenga miedo de entrar en el detalle de un problema.
Que combine empatía con el cliente y rigor operativo: un buen Customer Success Specialist resuelve, pero también documenta y previene.
Que tenga mentalidad de dueño: que dé seguimiento hasta cerrar, no solo hasta delegar.
Que sepa sostener un “todavía no” frente al cliente sin desgastar la relación.




Qué ofrecemos (¿por qué MagicLog?)

Ownership real: Serás responsable de tus cuentas y de tus implementaciones de principio a fin, con autonomía para decidir cómo resolverlas.

Crecimiento profesional: Desarrollarás una combinación poco común de habilidades —producto, datos, operación logística y relación con clientes— con posibilidad de crecer hacia roles de mayor alcance dentro del área.

Impacto directo: Tu trabajo se refleja en la adopción, la satisfacción y la retención de los clientes de una plataforma en plena expansión en LATAM.

Cultura de autonomía: Promovemos un ambiente basado en la confianza, el ownership, la colaboración y la mejora continua.

Trabajo remoto: Esquema completamente remoto, colaborando con equipos distribuidos en la región.

Experiencia en una LogTech internacional: Formarás parte de una empresa que está transformando la industria logística en Latinoamérica mediante tecnología e innovación.

title: CX Operations Specialist
description:
About the job

Buscamos un Customer Experience Operations Specialist (CX Operations Specialist) para una operación de atención que corre en tres mercados.




Es una posición de operaciones de experiencia del cliente: encontrar por qué la gente contacta, agrupar por causa raíz y convertir ese hallazgo en una automatización, un requerimiento de desarrollo o una mejora de producto. Y darle seguimiento hasta que se implemente.




🎯 Qué vas a hacer

- Analizar casos, contactos y conversaciones de los tres mercados agrupándolos por causa raíz, no por síntoma.

- Construir, publicar y mantener los indicadores de causa: volumen y motivo de contacto, recontacto, tiempo de resolución, escalaciones y concentración por proveedor o método de pago.

- Llevar los hallazgos a quien puede corregirlos (Producto, Marketing, Ingeniería, entre otros) con evidencia de la operación, y darles seguimiento hasta la corrección o una decisión documentada.

- Administrar y configurar las plataformas del área (flujos, disparadores, automatizaciones, formularios, vistas y reportes), con la configuración documentada.

- Automatizar lo repetitivo, incluida la gestión del asistente automatizado: alcances, contención de casos y calidad de respuestas.

- Traducir la necesidad operativa en requerimientos con criterios de aceptación, priorizar el backlog, destrabar dependencias y validar cada implementación antes de cerrarla.




🛠️ Con qué vas a trabajar

- Plataforma de atención a clientes: configuración de flujos, automatizaciones, disparadores y reportes.

- Datos crudos de la operación para construir indicadores desde cero.

- Asistentes automatizados y herramientas de análisis y automatización del área.




🔍 Qué necesitamos de ti

- Dos años o más en operaciones de atención a clientes, soporte, helpdesk u operaciones similares, o en análisis de información operativa.

- Haber configurado una plataforma operativa (atención a clientes, CRM, ticketing, automatización o similar): flujos, automatizaciones, disparadores y reportes.

- Construir indicadores desde datos crudos, identificar causas raíz y presentar conclusiones accionables.

- Experiencia levantando requerimientos técnicos hacia desarrollo y dando seguimiento hasta la implementación.

- Licenciatura concluida en Ingeniería, Sistemas, Administración, Actuaría o afín.




🧠 Cómo trabajamos

- Los hallazgos no se quedan en el aire: cada análisis termina en algo implementado o en una decisión documentada.

- Vas a resolver la configuración de la plataforma con autonomía técnica, dentro de la política de accesos y validando con Cumplimiento lo que aplique.

- Cuando otra área bloquea algo, escalas con una propuesta y consigues el avance.

- Los requerimientos se escriben con criterios claros para que se implementen sin retrabajos.




📍 Dónde y por qué

- Presencial en Monterrey, Nuevo León

- Tiempo completo

- Coordinas con customer care y con desarrollo

- Vas a trabajar de cerca con Producto, Marketing, Ingeniería y Cumplimiento

description:
About the job

What Makes Cloudbeds Unique:

At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 




How You'll Make an Impact:

As a leader within the Customer Onboarding Team, you will cultivate a highly effective, close-knit, and collaborative team that consistently delivers exceptional support. By ensuring seamless and successful onboarding experiences, your leadership directly translates into immediate value realization and long-term retention for our customers.




In this role, you will champion our AI Smarts + Hospitality Hearts mission, guiding your team to move from a pure training function to a strategic business partnership. You will lead a group of Caring Rebels who model Hospitality Before Efficiency, empowering clients to use our platform to deliver an experience of Unreasonable Hospitality. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and are ready to make a significant impact by guiding, mentoring, and setting the standard for a deeply personalized customer journey, we look forward to having you lead the way!




Our Customer Onboarding Team:

Our Onboarding team is where Hospitality Hearts meet Smart Solutions. We are a fully remote group of former hoteliers and customer experience professionals, focused on removing unnecessary manual work so we can spend more time on our "human magic": building and strengthening relationships, and ensuring our customers feel confident and supported from day one. If you are driven by emotional intelligence, trust-building, and delivering deeply personalized hospitality moments instead of repetitive operational tasks, you and your team will feel right at home here.




What You Bring to the Team:

• Embody the Caring Rebel Mindset: 

Cultivate, mentor, motivate, and empower a world-class team of Onboarding Coaches to care for our customers and their properties just as they would for a guest in a hotel.




• Standardize the Repeatable, Personalize the Meaningful:

 Drive the adoption of AI and modern tooling across your team to eliminate administrative drag, freeing them up to focus on strategic onboarding guidance, deep product adoption, and human magic.




• Lead Performance & Growth:

 Own the preparation, execution, and follow-up for 1-on-1s, check-ins, and performance reviews. Identify, communicate, and facilitate learning and career-growth opportunities for each member of your team.




• Strategic Portfolio Management:

 Monitor a segment of Cloudbeds customers with associated retention goals, analyzing utilization and customer data independently to discover insights and improve the onboarding experience.




• Escalation & Advocacy:

 Serve as a confident, knowledgeable, and patient escalation point for complex technical or operational inquiries from clients, third-party stakeholders, and key decision-makers.




• Cross-Functional Collaboration:

 Partner with Sales, Product, and Support to convert onboarding feedback into systemic operational improvements, shortening delivery timeframes and ensuring Cloudbeds' value is realized early.




• Thought Leadership:

 Provide leadership in hospitality training, ensuring full client context is maintained throughout the journey, and that all new knowledge is captured, searchable, and reusable.




• Commercial Mindset:

 Partner with Sales to define success, demonstrate ROI, drive customer retention, promote product value, and identify upsell opportunities.




• Data-Driven Success:

 Design, implement, and track quantitative and qualitative metrics to measure the success of projects, people, and processes, including driving best practices around customer outreach for reviews.




What Sets You Up for Success:

• Show Strong AI Smarts: 

Exceptional technical aptitude and learning agility. You work seamlessly with AI, pick up new software quickly, and feel comfortable adapting to evolving technology to unlock more time for personalized relationships.




• Demonstrate Your Hospitality Heart:

 Over 2 years of direct leadership experience within a hospitality property (e.g., Front Desk Manager, Revenue Manager, Concierge) or at least 3 years of relevant Hospitality SaaS industry experience in a customer-facing leadership/matrix role. (Prior experience as a Senior or Key Account Onboarding Coach within Cloudbeds is a major plus).




• Empathy & Relationship Champion: 

High emotional intelligence with a proven ability to build trust, resolve competing priorities under pressure, and create relationships across all levels of an organization (internally and externally).




• Agile Leadership:

 Ability to manage people, processes, and accounts effectively in an agile system and matrix reporting environment, while overseeing comprehensive learning and development plans for your team.




• Clear Communicator: 

Ability to clearly, concisely, and confidently synthesize technical and business concepts in both written and verbal contexts.




• Operational Excellence: 

Highly accountable, data-driven, and detail-oriented with background experience in modern operating systems (CRMs like Salesforce, OTAs, PMS backgrounds, etc.).




• Inclusive Outlook: 

Comfortable leading and working alongside people from diverse cultures and backgrounds.




Recommended Skills to Stand Out:

1. Fluency or working knowledge of Spanish, Portuguese, English, Thai, or Tagalog.

2. Project Management or Change Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Prosci).

3. Hospitality degree preferred.




What to Expect - Your Journey with Us

Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. 




Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. Descripción de la empresa EBC Financial Group es una empresa fundada en Londres que ofrece servicios financieros integrales, incluyendo brokerage, gestión de activos y servicios de inversión e inmigración. Contamos con presencia global en Londres, Tokio, Sídney, Singapur, Hong Kong y las Islas Caimán, lo que te permitirá trabajar con equipos y clientes internacionales. Nuestro equipo directivo suma décadas de experiencia en mercados financieros globales y sitúa la seguridad de los fondos de los clientes como máxima prioridad, operando bajo licencias de organismos reguladores como la FCA (Reino Unido), CIMA (Islas Caimán) y ASIC (Australia). Somos socio oficial de divisas del FC Barcelona y colaboramos con iniciativas de impacto junto a la UN Foundation, la Universidad de Oxford y otros aliados en salud global, economía, educación y sostenibilidad. Si te interesa el sector financiero regulado y orientado a la ética, EBC es un entorno dinámico para desarrollar tu carrera.

Descripción del puesto En el puesto de Customer Support en EBC Financial Group, serás la primera persona de contacto para las consultas y necesidades de clientes a nivel internacional. En tu día a día atenderás solicitudes vía correo electrónico, chat y teléfono, proporcionarás soporte técnico básico sobre plataformas de trading y servicios financieros, y ayudarás a resolver incidencias de forma rápida y clara. También te encargarás de hacer seguimiento de casos, registrar interacciones en las herramientas internas y colaborar con otros equipos para mejorar la satisfacción de clientes y la calidad del servicio. Este es un puesto de tiempo completo, presencial, ubicado en el área metropolitana de Ciudad de México.

Aptitudes sólidas en atención al cliente y Customer Support, con foco en la satisfacción y experiencia de la persona usuaria.Aptitudes interpersonales para comunicarte de forma clara y empática, gestionar conflictos y crear relaciones de confianza con clientes de perfiles diversos.Capacidad para proporcionar Technical Support, comprender procesos y productos financieros, y trasladar información técnica de forma sencilla.Aptitudes analíticas para interpretar datos de servicio, detectar patrones en incidencias y proponer mejoras en procesos y herramientas.Formación mínima en áreas relacionadas (administración, finanzas, economía o similares) y manejo fluido de herramientas digitales y ofimáticas.Nivel alto de inglés hablado y escrito es un must; se valorará conocimiento de otros idiomasExperiencia previa en FX y CFDs es un gran must Capacidad para trabajar en equipo, orientación a resultados y disposición para aprender en un entorno regulado y dinámico.

description:
About the job

🇲🇽 USD 18,000 to USD 22,000 per year, depending on experience, on a full time, contractor contract

🌎 Fully remote working from anywhere in Mexico!

✨ Working with globally recognisable brands in US Entertainment

💻 Work with modern hardware, social publishing tools, productivity systems, and AI-enabled workflows.




The standard hours for this role are 3pm-12am PT, Monday to Friday. 




Who We Are 




Founded in 2008, Storm Ideas is an international team working with globally recognised clients, particularly across the US TV and entertainment industry.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, technology, creativity, and operations. We produce social content at scale, support major entertainment brands, build products, and keep improving how our teams work.




We are remote-first, fast-moving, and increasingly AI-native in how we operate. AI tools and agentic workflows are becoming part of the way our teams plan, check, coordinate, research, report, and improve work. The standard is not “let AI do it”. The standard is better work: clearer briefs, faster execution, sharper checks, stronger judgment, and repeatable workflows that keep quality high.




About The Role 




We are hiring an AI Social Media Coordinator to help run the day-to-day social presence of major US TV and entertainment brands.

The craft is familiar: scheduling, reviewing, coordinating, optimising, checking, escalating, and keeping content moving. How we do that work is changing fast.




This is not a pure creative content role and it is not passive admin. The core of the job is client-safe social media operations: making sure content is scheduled, checked, approved, published, documented, and improved with strong attention to detail.




You will first learn what good looks like for our clients and why it matters. Then you will work with Storm’s social tools, workflow systems, and AI-enabled ways of working to help make the role faster, clearer, and more reliable.




The strongest candidates will already be practical and curious about AI. We are not looking for someone who uses AI only as a search box or autocomplete. We are looking for someone who can brief tools carefully, use them for bounded pieces of work, review what comes back with a critical eye, and keep improving how they use them.




If that already feels like how you work, this role is likely to suit you.




What You’ll Make Happen 

Put the client experience and publishing accuracy at the heart of everything you do.
Optimise YouTube content with effective titles, thumbnails, copy, metadata, and publishing checks.
Schedule, review, and coordinate social content across YouTube channels and social networks.
Support day-to-day community management across client social channels by monitoring and responding to audience comments and messages in line with agreed brand guidance, and escalating sensitive or complex interactions appropriately.
Clear dependencies proactively, including assets, copy, captions, approvals, account access, platform requirements, timings, and client expectations.
Coordinate with client contacts and Storm’s content production, copywriting, captioning, and social teams so work moves without avoidable gaps or surprises.
Use AI tools and workflow systems to support repeatable coordination work, including calendar planning, dependency chasing, content checks, research, account audits, reporting, and documentation.
Review AI-assisted work critically before it reaches clients, platforms, or internal stakeholders.
Research clients’ shows, movies, channels, competitors, and audiences so social recommendations are grounded in useful context.
Monitor social platform updates and identify practical changes that matter for client accounts.
Help document and improve internal processes so that good ways of working become repeatable across the team.
Escalate clearly when something is blocked, risky, unclear, late, or outside your authority, bringing evidence and a sensible next step.




Your Expertise 

Hands-on social media coordination, publishing, community, content operations, or adjacent digital experience.
Practical AI fluency: you have used AI tools in real work, study, or personal projects, and can explain how you check their output.
Strong attention to detail, especially around copy, timing, assets, approvals, account selection, links, platform requirements, and final pre-publish checks.
Clear written communication and the ability to explain what is done, what is blocked, what is risky, and what needs a decision.
Strong organisation and workload management across multiple accounts, deadlines, and stakeholders.
Comfort using social publishing tools, spreadsheets, project management systems, documentation, and other workflow tools.
A systems mindset: you see repeated work as something that can be made clearer, safer, and more efficient.
Curiosity about social platforms, audience behaviour, entertainment brands, and the changing AI tooling landscape.
Sound judgment about when to act independently, when to ask, when to escalate, and when not to publish.
Ability to analyse information qualitatively and quantitatively, then turn it into useful recommendations.
High agency: you do not wait passively for perfect instructions when there is a sensible next step to take.




What Success Looks Like 

Content goes out on the right account, at the right time, with the right assets, copy, metadata, approvals, and platform checks.
Client contacts and internal teams trust you because your updates are clear, accurate, and useful.
You catch issues early: missing assets, unclear approvals, broken links, platform constraints, scheduling conflicts, weak copy, mismatched account details, or risky assumptions.
You use AI and workflow tools to make repeatable work faster and more reliable, without handing over judgment.
You improve the operating system around the work: checklists, documentation, calendar views, QA steps, escalation routes, reporting, and lessons learned.
You distinguish urgent execution from optional strategy, and you know how to keep both moving at the right level.
You make the team calmer and more effective because the details are visible, controlled, and followed through.




This Role Will Suit You If

You enjoy the operational side of social media: coordination, publishing, QA, process, timing, and follow-through.
You like using modern tools to make repeated work more reliable.
You care about accuracy and client trust as much as you care about ideas.
You are comfortable working across multiple accounts and deadlines without losing detail.
You want to work in an AI-native team and are ready to bring those methods into everyday social media coordination.
You can take feedback, improve your process, and keep raising your own standard.




This Role Will Not Suit You If

You mainly want a creative strategy role with little day-to-day coordination.
You are uncomfortable with detailed checks, repeated processes, or publishing accountability.
You treat AI-generated output as finished work without reviewing it.
You wait for someone else to notice problems that you could reasonably have surfaced.
You prefer broad social media opinions over client-safe execution and evidence-backed recommendations.




What It’s Like to Work Here 




Modern Tools And Working Methods

Work with current hardware, social tools, productivity systems, and a properly supported AI stack. You will be expected to learn the tools, use them thoughtfully, and help improve how the work gets done.




Agility And Openness For Ideas

We actively encourage people to bring forward ideas that improve how teams work. We value practical experimentation, quick learning, and clear follow-through.




Client And Audience Impact

Our work supports major entertainment brands. Small details can matter: timing, approvals, links, copy, thumbnails, account selection, and platform rules all affect trust.




Remote-First Working

This role is fully remote within Mexico. Your normal workday will start at 3pm Pacific Time.




RECRUITMENT PROCESS 




First, you will receive questions to answer via a self-recorded video.




If successful, we will invite you to an interview (60 minutes via MS Teams). During the meeting, Bella, our Head of Social Media Management, will get to know you and try to understand if you’d be a good fit for the role, and at the same time answer all your questions.




Following this, there will be a short task to test your attention to detail and communication skills.

There may also be a short (30 minutes via MS Teams) follow-up interview with Duncan, our Chief Operating Officer.




And that’s it!

description:
About the job

Job Description

ABOUT US 

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, we're the world's leading premium drinks company. From global icons like Johnnie Walker, Guinness and Tanqueray to Smirnoff and Don Julio, we create brands consumers love. Bring your passion and use your curiosity as you explore, collaborate and innovate. Together with passionate people from all over the world, you'll test new ideas, learn and grow, and unlock a brighter, more exciting future. Join us to create a career worth celebrating.

About The Function

Finance at Diageo is about more than the numbers, it's about shaping the decisions behind them. From guiding investment to unlocking growth, this team plays a critical role in how we perform today and how we plan for tomorrow. You'll work with data, insight and digital tools to influence strategy and help drive a business that operates at global scale. It's a fast-moving environment where no two days are the same, and where you'll be supported to build your skills, grow your career and make a real impact.

About This Role

We are looking for a commercially minded and analytically driven Commercial Finance Manager, Marketing & Innovation to partner with our Marketing team and help shape investment decisions that drive sustainable growth across our portfolio. Acting as a trusted business partner, this role provides ongoing financial analysis, business modelling and performance insights to support Strategic Planning, AOP, forecasting and innovation initiatives. Success in this role means providing actionable insights, influencing key business decisions and maximizing returns on commercial investments.

Role Responsibilities


Partner closely with Marketing teams to provide financial insights and decision support for brands, innovations and commercial initiatives. 
Deliver ongoing financial analysis, modelling and business performance insights. 
Support Strategic Planning, AOP and forecasting processes. 
Analyze performance against plan, previous year and business targets, identifying risks and opportunities. 
Drive performance visibility across brand P&Ls and support commercial decision-making. 
Evaluate Advertising & Promotion (A&P) effectiveness and recommend optimization opportunities. 
Support productivity initiatives and value creation opportunities across brands. 
Manage controls related to pricing and A&P investments. 
Own performance dashboards, reporting routines and business performance visibility. 
Build business cases and financial models to support investments and strategic decisions. 
Support long-term strategic initiatives and special projects. 


Experience / Skills Required


3-5 years of experience in Finance, Commercial Finance, FP&A, Business Performance or related disciplines. 
Experience partnering with commercial, marketing or business teams. 
Strong financial modelling, analytical and business insight capabilities. 
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills (mandatory). 
Experience building business cases, forecasts and performance reporting. 
Strong presentation, communication and stakeholder management skills. 
Experience with Power BI and SAP is highly desirable. 
Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Finance or a related field. 
Experience within FMCG or Consumer Goods environments is highly valued. 
Advanced English proficiency is highly desirable. 
Proactive mindset, learning agility, and strong planning and organizational skills. 


Flexibility is key to our success. Talk to us about what flexibility means to you, so that you're supported to manage your wellbeing and balance your priorities from day one.

We recognize and value performance, offering our people a highly competitive Rewards and Benefits package.

Our purpose is to celebrate life, every day, everywhere. And creating an inclusive culture, where everyone feels valued and that they can belong, is a crucial part of this.

We embrace diversity in the broadest possible sense. This means that you'll be welcomed and celebrated for who you are just by being you.

Our ambition is to create the best performing, most trusted and respected consumer products companies in the world. Join us and help transform our business as we take our brands to new heights.

Feel inspired? Then this may be the opportunity for you.

If you require a reasonable adjustment, please ensure that you capture this information when you submit your application.

RECRUITMENT SCAM WARNING 

Protecting candidates is very important to us. All communications regarding your application will come from an email address ending in @diageo.com. In our recruitment process, we will never ask for money.

Descripción de la empresa Lúminos Marketing es una empresa consultora de marketing especializada en imagen corporativa, investigación de mercados y e-marketing. Nació en marzo de 2009 al detectar que muchas empresas necesitaban una planificación e implementación de marketing efectiva, especialmente en épocas de crisis. Trabajamos principalmente con pequeñas y medianas empresas, adaptando nuestros servicios a sus necesidades, objetivos y capacidad de inversión. Para cada cuenta realizamos un diagnóstico y diseñamos soluciones personalizadas que mejoran el retorno sobre la inversión y la rentabilidad. Nuestra misión y visión se apoyan en valores como compromiso, trabajo, lealtad, respeto y honestidad, buscando relaciones duraderas con clientes satisfechos.
Descripción del puesto Como Becario de marketing digital en Lúminos Marketing, colaborarás en la creación, ejecución y seguimiento de campañas de marketing online para diferentes cuentas. En tu día a día apoyarás la gestión de redes sociales, la redacción de contenidos digitales, la actualización de páginas web y la coordinación de acciones de comunicación online. También participarás en la recopilación y análisis de datos de campañas, preparando informes sencillos de resultados y proponiendo pequeñas mejoras. Es un puesto de tiempo completo, con trabajo presencial en nuestras oficinas situadas en San Luis Potosí, SLP, donde colaborarás estrechamente con el equipo de consultoría y creatividad.
Requisitos
 

Aptitudes en marketing digital y online marketing, con interés en aprender sobre planificación y ejecución de campañas.
Conocimientos básicos de social media marketing y gestión de redes sociales (contenido, calendario, interacción con comunidades).
Capacidad para utilizar herramientas de web analytics y medir resultados de campañas digitales.
Buenas aptitudes de comunicación escrita y oral, con capacidad para adaptar el mensaje a diferentes públicos.
Formación en marketing, comunicación, publicidad o áreas afines (estudios en curso o recién finalizados).
Manejo básico de herramientas ofimáticas y plataformas digitales (por ejemplo, gestores de contenidos, redes sociales, hojas de cálculo).
Actitud proactiva, ganas de aprender, trabajo en equipo y orientación a resultados.

Why Join Us?

At Ruvixx, we are building a smarter digital engine. We move beyond standard marketing to blend high-impact, content-led demand generation, rapidly optimized paid media, and high-performing web experiences. We are a team that values data, strategic experimentation, and clear, measurable results. If you are driven by performance and love turning complex data into a winning strategy, you will thrive here.




We are seeking a mid-level Digital Marketing Specialist to lead our Digital pod. In this critical role, you will own the architecture and management of our entire digital growth engine—spanning web, paid search/social (Google/LinkedIn), content syndication, and lead capture.

You will be responsible for setting the strategy, maintaining high-quality standards, and fostering a culture of rapid experimentation to drive measurable pipeline impact.




What You Will Own

Pod Leadership: Lead and manage the Digital pod, setting priorities, maintaining quality, and driving performance.
Measurement Architecture: Build and optimize a comprehensive measurement framework using GA4, GTM (client and server-side), and Looker Studio.
B2B Paid Media: Oversee all B2B paid media operations, including Google Ads (keyword strategy, budget pacing) and LinkedIn Ads (advanced targeting, creative testing).
Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Drive our CRO strategy through A/B testing, landing page optimization, and user experience analysis (using tools like Wix/WordPress, heatmaps).
Marketing Operations Alignment: Collaborate with Marketing Ops to optimize lead flow, scoring, and nurtures within Marketo/Salesforce.
Strategic Reporting: Develop and present data-backed digital strategies for internal and client stakeholders, complete with hypotheses, budgets, and impact forecasts.




Core Requirements

Performance & Attribution Expert: You are highly confident in GA4 (events, explorations), GTM, and Looker Studio. You understand attribution modeling and B2B funnel analysis.
Paid Media Strategist: You have hands-on experience running and scaling campaigns in Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads for B2B audiences.
Web & CRO Advocate: You have a strong grasp of A/B testing, landing page optimization, and UX principles.
B2B Tech Marketer: You have a working knowledge of B2B SEO principles and marketing automation platforms (Marketo or Salesforce).
A Data Storyteller: You can translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and leadership.
A Natural Leader: You set high standards for execution and can align cross-functional teams (Sales, MOPS, CS).
AI-Literate: You practically use AI for briefs, QA, and content repurposing.




Nice to Have

SEO & AIO Advocate: You look beyond traditional search rankings, staying ahead of the curve on the emerging landscape of Artificial Intelligence Optimization (AIO). You understand how generative search experiences impact brand visibility and are eager to experiment with strategies that capture both traditional organic and AI-driven discovery.




The First 90 Days: A Path to Impact

This role includes a 90-day (3-month) introductory and evaluation period focused on clear deliverables:

By 30 Days: Complete a full audit of digital channels, tracking, and lead flows. Deliver a comprehensive measurement plan and address critical leaks.
By 60 Days: Launch 6-8 new experiments across paid media and web; build out core performance dashboards and demonstrate initial lift.
By 90 Days: Deliver a documented Digital Playbook for Ruvixx, outlining proven, scalable programs ready for clients.




How to Apply

Ruvixx is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. If you are passionate about building data-driven growth engines and meet the criteria above, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't check every single box.

The GSIO Workforce Management Planning Team consists of our Senior Manager, 3 Workforce Managers, multiple Workforce Planners/Schedulers and RTAs. Enjoy a comfortable team-oriented environment where things are always happening at a rapid pace and you can prioritize and organize tasks simultaneously. Manage outcomes and be empowered to make the decisions to lead to those outcomes. Be focused on quality, output-motivated, an extreme achiever who is progressive, and always pushing yourself to be 1% better each day!

About the Role

As one of DoorDash's core operations teams, Support Ops is tasked with ensuring that when there are bumps in the last mile there's always someone there to help make things right. Our team designs, manages and operates DoorDash's massive and growing global network of support centers, with the ultimate goal of delivering a world-class customer experience every time.

As part of DoorDash's Support Operations Team, we're looking for an experienced Workforce Planner to help develop and scale our support lines of businesses in the Mexico City area. This role will be a key player in planning our monthly, daily, and hourly staffing levels and ensure we're providing our customers with best-in-class service with up to date hiring plans. This role will play a vital part in improving forecast accuracy, reporting, and planning around floor staff utilization and efficiency.

You're excited about this opportunity because you will…


Build and maintain support capacity plan models at a monthly, weekly, and interval level for a large, 24/7/365 organization.
Forecast incoming contacts based on Delivery volume, Mx and Dx onboarding.
Analysis on historical data to provide insights that improve support operations.
Guide Short-Term staffing adjustments to address current staffing gaps.
Work with our operations team to track how our staffing is being implemented and optimized. Make proactive and corrected improvements.
Partner with Real Time Analysts for demand insight and outage reporting.
Build out and report on seasonality trends in a complex, growing integrity organization.
Produce, dig into and use data and insights to identify opportunities to improve speed, quality, effectiveness, and customer experience
Partner with teams within integrity, customer experience, and our product, engineering, and tools teams to improve processes and the resulting customer experience for consumers, merchants, and dashers, and helping DoorDash become a safe and trustworthy platform
Accomplish your recommendations from start to finish, from digging into Excel/SQL to creating a budget to implementing timelines, aligning partners, testing ideas, achieving and measuring results
Identify areas for improvement and/or innovation around efficiency and customer experience from deep dives and understanding customer's cases; drive new ideas to be built and tested


We're excited about you because…


Analytical and data driven - you love getting into the weeds.
Enjoy attacking complex problems and building something that hasn't existed before.
Well-organized and attentive to detail; have outstanding written and verbal communications skills.
Impeccable follow-up and follow-through capabilities, you can execute and get the job done.
Comfortable in a fast-paced, constantly changing, team-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously.
Have an owner mentality; you're focused on quality, output driven, an extreme hustler, proactive, and always pushing yourself to do better.
You are eager to bring solutions to big challenges in creative new ways
You like to dig in. You don't hesitate to get in the weeds and operate at the lowest level of detail, but you're as comfortable thinking long-term and inspiring a team.
You're unafraid of the unknown. Rapid change and learning is exciting to you, and you excel in constant change.
You love data. You let data win arguments, and you're comfortable pulling data or modeling in Excel/Google Sheets.
You don't give up. If your plan doesn't work, you have 3 more options in your back pocket.
You have 4+ years of post-grad experience. You've succeeded in diverse cultures (whether in tech, operations, strategy, consulting, banking, or a related experience).


About DoorDash

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. We're committed to supporting employees' happiness, healthiness, and overall well-being by providing comprehensive benefits and perks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. About The Job

The GTM Performance, Analytics and Cloud Excellence (PACE) team, a vital part of the Customer Experience organization, is dedicated to accelerating Google Cloud business generation through a data-driven and field-centric strategy. This involves guiding and monitoring sales plays and consumption activities across the entire Cloud business, empowering both field teams and leadership with data-informed insights. Our primary objective is to foster a strong Cloud consumption culture within the Go-to-Market (GTM) organization.

As a Startups Performance Lead for data-driven sales targeting and performance, you will lead the design, governance, and scaling of customer targeting intelligence to power go-to-market (GTM) sales plays across Google Cloud’s scaled segments (SMB, startups, and corporate). You will own the evolution of multi-source propensity models, translating first-party consumption data, third-party signals, and buyer intent into actionable, high-yield targeting lists, while directly leading the deployment of these models within the startup segment.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic executive execution. Partnering with cross-functional leaders in Strategy and Operations, Business Intelligence, Applied AI GTM, and segment sales teams, you will establish rigorous performance measurement frameworks to track win-rate lifts, drive pipeline conversion, and optimize consumption. A primary focus will be scaling data-driven plays within the startup segment (via 'proven pathways'), operationalizing list delivery to frontline sellers, and presenting strategic targeting outcomes to executive leadership.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

US: $152000 - $221000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Responsibilities

Learn more about benefits at Google .


Serve as the global Startups Performance Lead for data-driven customer targeting across all scaled segments (SMB, ctartups, and corporate), establishing unified account prioritization methodologies.
Maintain and continuously refine targeting logic, integrating first-party usage, third-party firmographics, and buyer intent signals to optimize selectivity and align with product practice and business priorities.
Partner with Applied AI GTM, Sales Tooling, and BI teams to integrate targeting outputs into core frontline platforms driving high representative adoption and actionability.
Deploy targeting intelligence within the startup segment. Partner with the startup practice team to design sellers play portfolios and manage the day-to-day operations of delivering targeting lists via Cloud Connect.
Design and implement measurement frameworks and KPIs to track the commercial impact of targeted plays. Perform rigorous business analysis to iterate targeting logic and play content to optimize business generation capture.

description:
About the job

Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of.

Who We Are… 

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your New Role:
We are searching for an Senior Specialist Employee Services to join the Global Business Services (GBS) People & Culture (P&C) team. In this role, the Senior Specialist provides efficient and highly informative first point-of-contact service to all employees, their managers and business partners. 
 
Focused on a seamless customer experience and great customer care, the Senior Specialist uses information from multiple systems and resources to respond to inquiries; provides navigational support to employees on self-service/HR tools such as Workday and ServiceNow and routing/escalating inquiries for advanced support. Using the case management system, the Senior Specialist accurately processes, records, closes or escalates transactions in accordance with established service level agreements. This role collects required information or back-up documentation from employees or external customers. This includes tactfully asking customers probing questions to establish context and ensure the solutions offered or the escalation path is appropriate and most likely to succeed. 
 
The Senior Specialist role provides feedback internally, proposing new and effective ways to resolve problems and improve productivity (i.e., continuous improvement efforts), while maintaining broad knowledge of policies, procedures, and resources. 
 
Your Role Accountabilities:

Analyze and resolve different types of requests from employees or clients.
Handle inbound requests via phone, email, the HR-Portal, or other access channels. 
Perform individual employee data transactions and data-entry in Workday and other systems. 
Troubleshoot payroll and time off inquiries, recalculations, employment verifications (VOE/VOIs), direct deposit setups, pay and tax document re-issues, data updates, etc. 
Provide support for self-service and P&C technology tools for employees and customers. 
Ensure completeness of case notes, aligning with company and audit expectations.
Assisting customers to increase awareness of self-service resources and promote self-sufficiency. 
Ensure confidentiality information when processing transactions and addressing employee inquiries. 
Perform and track administrative (no call) departmental tasks, including report reviewing, data updates, mailing, filing, sending correspondence, and records management. 

 
Qualifications & Experience:

Bachelor’s degree in human resources or related field
Fluent in English 
Experience with Human Resources administrative or related experience required, preferably with supervisory responsibilities from a global entertainment environment.
Must be able to maintain confidentiality and use confidential information appropriately.




How We Get Things Done…

This last bit is probably the most important! Here at WBD, our guiding principles are the core values by which we operate and are central to how we get things done. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take seriously our responsibility to consider qualified candidates on the basis of merit, regardless of sex, gender identity, ethnicity, union status, age, sexual orientation, religion or belief, marital status, pregnancy, parenthood, disability or any other category protected by law.

If you’re a qualified candidate with a disability and you require adjustments or accommodations during the job application and/or recruitment process, please visit our accessibility page for instructions to submit your request.
